name: illustrative-compliance-policy
comment: Translated from MODULE-COMPLIANCE clauses. Compiled MIB modules only retain GROUP references; conditional wording and MIN-ACCESS clauses lost at compile time are captured here verbatim in policy terms.

groups.condition: device generates SNMP messages for which a response is expected (retries/timeouts apply)
device includes an SNMP command responder application
device implements the SNMPv3 User-based Security Model (USM)

objects.condition: device generates SNMP messages for which a response is expected (retries/timeouts apply)
objects.reference: illustrative MIN-ACCESS clause attached to the response-app condition
